A competent reader closes this by taking the abstract trial space R^{m_k} with its standard basis and observation map M_k=L_k composed with Phi_k. The repair makes that realization explicit and verifies M_k(e_{k,j})=L_k(phi_{k,j}), leaving the same H_k, coefficient process and Kalman recursion. No new theorem, stronger hypothesis or changed conclusion is needed.
